terminal_comparison.aggregation_rule: Mean four sampled draws within each seed, mean the five registered seeds within each complete domain, then weight complete domains equally for all eight series.
terminal_comparison.partial_domain_policy: Retain available terminal arm means and exact seed n separately; never substitute earlier checkpoints or include partial blocks in the across-domain mean.
terminal_comparison.selection_rule: Include a domain in the main mean only when every registered seed has an admitted pass-8 endpoint in all four methods at both levels; select by availability before reading effects.
terminal_comparison.uncertainty: Descriptive seed means; no confidence intervals.
